lede: Mountain Village Council meets Thursday with a resolution to set the sale price appreciation cap on deed-restricted units — the kind of decision that determines whether affordable housing actually stays affordable or quietly slips away. The same night, Telluride's Planning and Zoning Commission gets its first look at a school district employee housing proposal on the high school campus. Squeeze in the BOCC's housing authority compliance discussion Wednesday, three public hearings at Ouray County Planning Commission, and a busy week at HARC, and there's a lot on the table before the free Deltaphonic show at Oak Street Park Thursday evening.
